contents.content:
Manyata Tech Park is a major IT hub in Bangalore, drawing professionals nationwide. Finding a comfortable place nearby is crucial for these professionals. This article highlights the best places to stay near Manyata Tech Park.

Table of Contents

Thanisandra, situated in North Bengaluru along Thanisandra Main Road, is gaining popularity. Surrounded by areas like Hebbal, Nagawara, HBR Layout, and Jakkur, it offers convenient shopping and socializing facilities. Many professionals employed at Manyata Tech Park opt to reside here.
Distance to Manyata tech park- 2.8 km
 Connectivity-Thanisandra is well-connected. It's 26 km from the airport, which takes about 40 minutes to reach by car. For trains, Yelahanka Junction is the main station, only 9 km away—a 25-minute ride. Getting around by road is easy too, with Thanisandra Main Road, the Outer Ring Road (ORR), Bellary Road, and Hennur Road all nearby. There's good news for metro fans too, A new metro line (Line 4) is being built and should be finished soon. This line will connect Thanisandra to other parts of the city. In the future, there are even plans to extend this line to the airport.There are plans to extend this line to the airport in the future.

Nagavara is a cool area in North Bengaluru. It's right next to HBR Layout and Thanisandra. Getting around is easy because Nagavara is close to other neighbourhoods like Hebbal, Thanisandra, Shampura, and Amrutahalli.
Distance to Manyata tech park-1 KM
Connectivity: Nagavara has great ways to get around. Buses run through the area from BMTC, which can take you to other parts of the city. There's a metro station called Goraguntepalya on the Green Line 9 km away. You can get there by taking NH75. For trains, Bengaluru Cantonment Railway Station is also 9 km away on Bellary Road. The airport is a bit further, at 28 km from Nagavara.

Hebbal is a growing area in North Bengaluru. It's on Bellary Road, near neighborhoods called RT Nagar, Nagawara and Thanisandra. There are tall apartment buildings in Hebbal, but also some buildings that are only a few floors high.
Distance to Manyata tech Park: 4.4 km
Connectivity-Hebbal is well-connected in Bengaluru. Getting around is easy with roads like Bellary Road, Outer Ring Road (ORR), and the Hebbal Flyover. Buses run through the area from BMTC, and there's even a train station in Hebbal. The airport is a bit far, 27.7 km away. There's another train station called  Krantivira Sangolli Rayanna Station 11 km away, which takes about 30 minutes to reach.

Hennur is a fast-growing area in North Bengaluru, right on the Outer Ring Road. Just a few years ago, it wasn't part of the busy city center. But now, as big companies have set up offices here,it is witnessing the emergence of numerous new apartments and houses, offering ample options for those seeking flats for rent n Hennur. It's also close to other areas like Hebbal, Nagavara, Banaswadi, and HRBR Layout, so getting around is easy.
Distance to Manyata tech park-5KM
Connectivity -Hennur Road lies 25 km from the International Airport and 13 .4km from both the City Railway Station and Kempegowda Bus Station. The renowned MG Road is a mere 8 km away, while the Banaswadi Railway Station is just 4 km from Hennur. Despite the absence of metro stations in the locality, the closest one, Baiyappanahalli (Purple Line), is only 7 km from Hennur.

Conclusion

Professionals seeking accommodation near ANZ Manyata Tech Park in Bangalore have several excellent options to consider, including Thanisandra, Nagavara, Hebbal, and Hennur.These areas have everything you need - convenience, good connections, and lots of amenities, making life easier for those working in the IT hub.
